steps.name: unit (changed)
steps.why: Only the tests the diff reaches, so the push stays inside the budget. The full suite runs in CI.

steps.name: audit
steps.why: High and critical advisories only. Lower levels fire on transitive dev dependencies and train everyone to ignore the check.

steps.name: e2e smoke
steps.why: A merge gate needs the critical paths, not the suite. Tag those specs @smoke; the rest runs nightly.

steps.name: deps drift
steps.why: Reports, never fails: npm outdated exits 1 whenever anything is behind, which is always.

steps.name: security scan
steps.why: Semgrep Community Edition ships on PyPI, not npm, so the runner needs python and pipx. --error turns findings into a non-zero exit.
